content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation on § 14.1 (Assignment), fallback target.**

- **Investigated:** § 14 (the only assignment clause, p0121), plus searches for "assign", change-of-control/merger language, and consent standards; § 11 termination was reviewed and contains no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right, so we are not in walk-away territory.
- **Already met:** mutual successor-assignment carve-out (merger, acquisition, sale of substantially all related assets) and a consent requirement for all other assignments.
- **Failed fallback:** no reasonableness standard on consent, and no written-notice mechanic for successor assignments.
- **Cure:** two surgical inserts into § 14.1 — "which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld" and "upon prior written notice to the other party" — preserving the mutual direct-competitor proviso and the null-and-void sentence. No affiliate no-consent carve-out was added, as that would conflict with the fallback requirement that every non-successor assignment need consent.
